integrity: Proof uses exact directed-edge contraction and orthogonal covariance decomposition for every integer n at least three; exact checks through n=7 are supplementary and not a substitute for the all-n proof. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-size covariance and sharp variance inequalities only; no limit theorem, independence assertion or optimization algorithm. Earlier general quadratic-assignment variance treatments could indirectly imply pieces of the entrywise covariance formula; independent historical-priority validation has not occurred.
title: Boundary-lifted covariance spectra for uniform directed Hamiltonian paths and cycles
